lines.text: Was Kizaru secretly protecting Luffy the entire time?

shot.fallback: admiral in yellow suit glowing with light

lines.text: Hear me out, because Oda left one strange clue on Egghead.

shot.fallback: exhausted boy lying on a lab floor

lines.text: In chapter 1103, Luffy is out of stamina and starving, and Saturn is standing over him.

shot.fallback: pale elder standing over a fallen hero

lines.text: Then food shows up. Out of nowhere.

shot.fallback: boy stuffing food in his mouth

lines.text: Nobody on that island could have delivered it that fast.
Then Oda answered a fan in the SBS, and he kept stressing the speed of light.

shot.fallback: author's hand drawing at a desk

lines.text: Only one person in this world moves at the speed of light.

shot.search: Kizaru Yata no Kagami light speed
shot.fallback: man turning into beams of light

lines.text: Now look at chapter 1093, where they actually fight.

shot.search: Luffy vs Kizaru Egghead Star Gun
shot.fallback: two fighters clashing, one made of light

lines.text: It ends in a draw, even though Borsalino can run circles around a tired Luffy.

shot.search: Luffy Kizaru Gomu Gomu no Star Gun
shot.fallback: rubber fist hitting a glowing admiral

lines.text: People say Kizaru just attacked the Straw Hats at Sabaody, so he's a villain.

shot.fallback: admiral attacking pirates on a grove

lines.text: But that's the thing: a Marine can obey orders and still feed the kid he was ordered to catch.
It's a theory, but I think Borsalino picked his side on Egghead.
So no, he wasn't just a villain. Was Kizaru secretly protecting Luffy the entire time?

shot.fallback: admiral and rubber boy facing each other

topic: Kizaru fed Luffy at light speed on Egghead: Oda's SBS says only someone with the speed of light could have done it
title: Was Kizaru Secretly Protecting Luffy The Whole Time?
description: Kizaru is a Marine Admiral, but Egghead hides a strange clue. Chapter 1103 shows Luffy getting food out of nowhere, and Oda's SBS points at light speed. Here's why I think Borsalino picked a side. Do you buy it?
comment: Is Kizaru a hidden ally of Luffy, or just a Marine who couldn't finish the job? Pick a side.
